author: New China TV
description:
Kindness needs no name.
At Xuancheng Railway Station, east China, a dog named "Chief Huang" spent years guarding travelers. When tragedy struck this April, leaving it severely injured, the local community didn't look away.
Over 40 taxi drivers rushed to its rescue, signing a donation list with nothing but their license plate numbers. Together with local animal lovers, they raised over 4,000 yuan to save a life.
title: Taxi drivers donate to save local stray dog
